title: CapabilityRiskRegistry
description: Normative capability risk-class assignment for SPEC-CAP (host API 0.13.0+). Revising an assignment is a data change.

namesDestination.description: The app can name where bytes go. Floors the class at sensitive.

irreversibleOrThirdParty.description: The effect is irreversible or visible to people who never approved this app. Floors the class at sensitive; required for critical.

readsSensorSecretOrForeignData.description: Reads a sensor, a secret, or another party's data. Floors the class at elevated.

standing.description: No per-operation confirmation; the grant stays live. Recorded for review, not a floor — standing benign grants (storage, presence) exist on purpose.
